fields.description: The pipeline stage mix for reports: deterministic_only (rules only, no LLM), deterministic_plus_narrative (rules + an LLM executive summary), autonomous_full (rules + AI investigation, Phase D), legacy_llm (the pre-v2 single-call behaviour, kept for A/B).
fields.label: Default AI Mode

fields.description: When set, the ai_mode passed to generate_discrepancy_report is honoured per run; otherwise the job always uses the Default AI Mode.
fields.label: Allow Per-Run AI Mode

fields.description: Model routed for clinical stages (document reading, clinical narrative, benefit explanation).
fields.label: Clinical Model

fields.description: Model routed for general stages (executive summary, generic explanation).
fields.label: General Model

fields.description: Optional JSON map of stage -> model override, e.g. {"narrative": "qwen3-27b", "investigator": "baichuan-m2-32b"}. Stages not listed use the clinical/general default for their class.
fields.label: Stage Model Routing (JSON)

fields.description: Pre-flight input token budget per LLM call (estimate vs the redacted digest); over budget the AI stage is skipped with a stored warning and the report still renders.
fields.label: Max Input Tokens (per call)

fields.description: Maximum LLM calls per AI stage (the initial call + one corrective retry).
fields.label: Max LLM Calls (per stage)

fields.description: JSON toggles for the PII redaction layer applied to anything sent to an LLM: {"phone": true, "cr_id": true, "id_numbers": true, "dob": true, "names": true, "email": true}.
fields.label: Redaction Policy (JSON)

fields.description: What happens to a finding whose evidence refs fail verification: exclude (drop it from the deliverable; it stays in the provenance audit) or mark (keep it, stamped unverified).
fields.label: Evidence Policy

fields.description: Optional JSON map of tag code -> severity used by the policy_table severity policy, e.g. {"CONTRIBUTION_GAP": "high"}.
fields.label: Severity Overrides (JSON)

fields.description: static: the HISI Benefit Intervention matrix (deterministic, seeded from the SHA matrices). live: the BenefitsExchange endpoint is authoritative per intervention code (falls back to static when the call fails; the source is stamped on every job).
fields.label: Benefits Mode

fields.description: Cache TTL in minutes for live BenefitsExchange results, keyed by intervention code (the API is a pure function of the code).
fields.label: Benefits Cache TTL (minutes)

fields.description: Base URL host for the BenefitsExchange (BMX) Intervention resource, e.g. https://uat.dha.go.ke. Empty falls back to the site DHA origin (HISI Settings base_url / simulation host). Auth is the site DHA JWT (consumer_key/consumer_secret), same as the other DHA APIs.
fields.label: Benefits Base URL
